title: Rust compress writes out buffer before failing: error returns leave partial bytes (decompress is atomic)
description: Confirmed empirically (discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-xuc8, robustness pass). compress_mqtt_sn (rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs:1014-1047) sets out[0]=RULE_MQTT_SN (:1017), zero-fills out[1..] via BitWriter (:143), writes residue and copies tail BEFORE the needed>out.len() check (:1044); enforce_encoded_profile_limit (:2161) fires only after full encoding written. Probe: input needing 121 bytes with 25-byte out -> Err(BufferTooSmall) with all 25 bytes modified, out[0]=0x07; over-profile input with 40000-byte out -> Err(profile limit) with all 40000 bytes written. decompress side is fully atomic on error (0 bytes modified) and Python is atomic by construction. No current in-repo caller reads out after Err (checked link.rs:263, decompress_authenticated_frame_tracked) so impact is latent, but the compress/decompress asymmetry is undocumented and any caller assuming error implies untouched buffer gets stale/garbage bytes. Fix: size-check before first write in compress_mqtt_sn (and audit other per-rule compress fns for the same pattern), or document the contract explicitly plus a regression test asserting buffer-untouched-on-error.
close_reason: Fixed compress_mqtt_sn per the bead's primary fix option: total encoded size (1 rule byte + branch-determined residue ceil: 154 bits -> 20 bytes link-local, 282 bits -> 36 full) is now computed BEFORE any write to out; Err(BufferTooSmall) returns with the buffer completely untouched, matching decompress's atomic error contract. This also removes the subtler mutation the bead's probe missed: BitWriter::new does buf.fill(0) on out[1..], so even zero writes zeroed the residue region. Added regression test mqtt_sn_compress_error_leaves_buffer_untouched (link-local 25-needed vs 24-out, full-address 38 vs 37, 0xAA sentinel asserted unchanged, exact-size success controls pin the arithmetic). Validation (scratch mirror of beads-worker-4; in-tree cargo still blocked by xyt6): full features 170/0, default 119/0, cargo fmt clean, clippy --all-targets clean. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge-cases via Kimi K3): all PASS — reviewer verified Ok-path bytes identical to the old code, error-payload (needed, available) semantics preserved for every reachable case, and NoMatchingRule/BufferTooSmall dispatcher precedence unchanged. Audit of the bead's 'other per-rule compress fns' clause completed: compress_coap, compress_icmpv6_echo, compress_rpl_dio, compress_rpl_dao retain mutate-then-check, and the dispatcher's enforce_encoded_profile_limit converts Ok->Err after full writes — both filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-emca (discovered-from this bead) rather than expanding this slice.
